create_image_processor: create a Cohere2VisionImageProcessor instance with custom crop_to_patches, min_patches, and max_patches settings
crop_image_to_patches: crop a torch.Tensor image into a grid of patches using optimal aspect ratio and configurable patch size
preprocess_images: preprocess a list of images by resizing, rescaling, and normalizing with optional patch cropping and batch grouping
get_optimal_tiled_canvas: get the optimal tile grid dimensions (width, height) that best fits an image within min and max tile constraints
get_all_supported_aspect_ratios: get all supported aspect ratio tile configurations up to a maximum number of image tiles
